text.tspan: Mismanaged plastic waste per capita vs. GDP per capita 2019
Mismanaged plastic waste is waste that is not recycled, incinerated, or kept in sealed landfills. It includes
materials burned in open pits, dumped into seas or open waters, or disposed of in unsanitary landfills and
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: Meijer et al. (2021); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
GDP per capita is measured in international-$ at 2021 prices to account for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
